text:
Maria Park: quick heads-up — Horizon SI is blocked on the last-mile network allowlist for their gov-cloud PoC, and they've asked for an architecture review + ops escalation.
Andre Singh: On it. what specifically is blocked?
Maria Park: partner says their security team won't open outbound 443 to our hosted control-plane. they need private-link + KMS proxy.
Jin Woo: if they can't reach control-plane, they won't be able to fetch model manifests or metrics. is this Private deployment or Dedicated?
Maria Park: Private (VPC) with marketplace distribution. marketplace image signed, but image pull works; control-plane telemetry + rollout APIs fail.
Sophia Patel: tagging the SI: @HorizonEng said they can do a VPC endpoint but need exact CIDR/ports and a cert thumbprint to whitelist.
Leo Chen: can we give them a stable egress IP? our control-plane is multi-az, not single IP. we can provide a set of prefixes and TLS cert fingerprint.
Andre Singh: for timeline: customer expects go/no-go window next Tue. need a runbook for the SI to follow.
Maria Park: IntegrationsBot: new escal ticket created INC-3821 (priority P2) assigned to eng-platform and partnerships.
IntegrationsBot: <https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-3821|INC-3821> — summary: Horizon SI - control-plane egress allowlist + KMS proxy integration.
Jin Woo: ok propose giving them:
```
- control-plane egress prefixes: 34.120.200.0/22, 34.121.60.0/23
- ports: 443 (TLS), 5222 (telemetry fallback)
- cert thumbprint: AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:01:02:03:04:05:06:07:08:09:0A
```
Sophia Patel: also we need them to share their proxy logs and a short tcpdump when they attempt handshake. helps confirm SNI and ALPN.
Leo Chen: note: if customer insists on no outbound 443, we can offer a Private Relay (customer-hosted relay that speaks to control-plane over an approved tunnel). that requires a short deployment on their infra.
Andre Singh: what's the ops owner for the relay pattern? Jin?
Jin Woo: I can own a minimal deployable (Docker) and a quick config guide. won't be enterprise-hardened but enough for PoC in 48 hours.
Maria Park: perfect. Andre — can you coordinate SI to schedule a 45m triage tomorrow? they need detailed runbook and who does what.
Andre Singh: scheduled 2026-03-25 16:00 PT with Horizon Eng + their security lead + Jin + Leo + me. invite sent.
Sophia Patel: I'll prep a 1-page checklist for the SI (whitelist entries, certs, tcpdump steps, fallback relay steps) and drop it in the thread after the sync.
Maria Park: also FYI marketing asked to hold the joint announcement until PoC netchecks pass. so timeline gating matters. :eyes:
Andre Singh: noted. we'll push for PoC within this sprint. if relay needed, flag for partner billing for extra engineering hours.
Jin Woo: after triage, I'll post a short config snippet they can run (iptables + curl test) and a small troubleshooting checklist.
IntegrationsBot: INC-3821 updated: triage meeting scheduled, attachments: runbook-draft (private).
Maria Park: thanks all. please post any pre-read or ask for pre-checks in this thread.
Sophia Patel: dropping runbook draft now — <link.internal/runbooks/horizon-allowlist-check.pdf>. feedback welcome. :+1:
Leo Chen: quick note — if KMS is customer-managed HSM, we'll need a contract SLA addendum. tagging legal in case.
Maria Park: copied. wrapping — goal is to unblock SI by Thu so marketing window stays open.
Andre Singh: thanks everyone, will follow up with minutes after the triage.
Sophia Patel: :rocket:
Jin Woo: ping me if they share pcap — I'll take a look after the call.
Maria Park: thread closed for now, will reopen if new blockers appear.
